ideas.pitch: An interactive 3D visualization and storytelling dashboard rendering Parker Solar Probe plasma and solar wind telemetry for educational outreach.
ideas.problem_statement: Creative Data Display with the Parker Solar Probe
ideas.title: ParkerSolarPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of a previous NASA Space Apps Global Championship winner by turning complex space agency data into an engaging, accessible narrative.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack tracking web app that maps local power grid consumption directly to regional coal and mineral supply chains using federal MSHA and EIA open datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: General Earth Science and Resource Tracking Challenge
ideas.title: GridToMine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages hard-to-parse government data combined with geospatial visualization, matching the winning formula of recent earth-data hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An ecological simulation and public awareness dashboard tracking local species migration, habitat fragmentation, and environmental stressors using open biodiversity data.
ideas.title: EcoSim Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals strongly to judges looking for public-facing educational tools with live simulation features and clean interactive dashboards.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance geospatial data pipeline and database tool processing multi-spectral satellite imagery to measure seasonal Arctic ice coverage changes.
ideas.problem_statement: Climate Change and Polar Ice Observation Challenge
ideas.title: ArcticIceMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates heavy data engineering chops and practical utility for climate researchers, replicating the technical depth of past challenge winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring tool that automatically flags illegal land encroachment and environmental violations around industrial zones.
ideas.problem_statement: Satellite Data Analysis for Environmental Protection
ideas.title: GeoSat-IndustrialCompliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with recent satellite monitoring wins by automating complex image classification tasks into actionable compliance reports for environmental regulators.
